project.title: Shanxi kingergarten microbiome,The settle dusts were collected by vacuum cleaner on the surface of the classrooms of the kindergardens, then they were sequenced on the Illumina MiSeq.
project.description: This is the first study to explore the long-term indoor microbiome dynamic and occupants’ health effects. The study demonstrates that drastic changes in air pollutants can reconstruct the indoor microbiome on a city scale, and microorganisms play an important mediating role in shaping the human health.
